title: Capstone 4: Generative AI – Variational Autoencoder 🎨
description: Build a VAE that learns to generate MNIST digits, mastering custom layers and training loops.

slides.title: Generating New Data 🤖
slides.content:
# What is a Variational Autoencoder (VAE)?

- An autoencoder compresses input into a latent code and reconstructs it.
- A VAE adds a probabilistic twist: the latent space is forced to follow a normal distribution.
- After training, you can sample random points in latent space and generate **new** realistic digits.

We'll implement:
- Custom encoder and decoder models.
- Reparameterization trick.
- Custom training loop with KL divergence loss.

slides.title: Define the Encoder and Decoder
slides.content: Encoder outputs mean and log‑variance; decoder reconstructs the image.
slides.codeSnippet:
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras import layers

class Encoder(tf.keras.Model):
    def __init__(self, latent_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = layers.Conv2D(32, 3, activation='relu', strides=2, padding='same')
        self.conv2 = layers.Conv2D(64, 3, activation='relu', strides=2, padding='same')
        self.flatten = layers.Flatten()
        self.dense_mean = layers.Dense(latent_dim)
        self.dense_logvar = layers.Dense(latent_dim)

    def call(self, x):
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        z_mean = self.dense_mean(x)
        z_logvar = self.dense_logvar(x)
        return z_mean, z_logvar

slides.title: Decoder and Reparameterization
slides.content: Decoder uses `Conv2DTranspose` to upsample back to image.
slides.codeSnippet:
class Decoder(tf.keras.Model):
    def __init__(self, latent_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.dense = layers.Dense(7*7*32, activation='relu')
        self.reshape = layers.Reshape((7,7,32))
        self.deconv1 = layers.Conv2DTranspose(64, 3, activation='relu', strides=2, padding='same')
        self.deconv2 = layers.Conv2DTranspose(32, 3, activation='relu', strides=2, padding='same')
        self.out = layers.Conv2DTranspose(1, 3, activation='sigmoid', padding='same')

    def call(self, z):
        x = self.dense(z)
        x = self.reshape(x)
        x = self.deconv1(x)
        x = self.deconv2(x)
        return self.out(x)

def reparameterize(mean, logvar):
    eps = tf.random.normal(shape=mean.shape)
    return eps * tf.exp(logvar * 0.5) + mean

slides.title: VAE Model and Custom Train Step
slides.content: Override `train_step` to add KL divergence loss.

slides.title: Train and Generate New Digits
slides.codeSnippet:
# Load MNIST
(x_train, _), (x_test, _) = tf.keras.datasets.mnist.load_data()
x_train = x_train.astype('float32') / 255.0
x_train = x_train[..., tf.newaxis]  # add channel

train_ds = tf.data.Dataset.from_tensor_slices(x_train).shuffle(1000).batch(64)

vae = VAE(latent_dim=2)  # small for visualisation
vae.compile(optimizer='adam')
vae.fit(train_ds, epochs=10)

# Generate new samples
random_z = tf.random.normal(shape=(16, 2))
generated = vae.decoder(random_z)
# Plot generated images...
